method: Independent first opening of each original PNG using functions.view_image detail original, before constructing or reading any older figure spec. No answer key used.

figures.description: One rectangular two-branch parallel capacitor network, not an array with omitted extra capacitors.

groups.description: Exactly two thick vertical separated plates on the top branch, the left positive and the right negative in the depicted charged state. C_1 is printed above the pair. +|q_1| appears above/left and -|q_1| above/right. Wires meet the middle of the respective plates.

Exactly two thick vertical separated plates on the bottom branch, again left positive and right negative. +|q_2| is below/left, -|q_2| below/right, and C_2 below the pair. Separate q_1 and q_2 magnitudes are printed; the pixels do not assert they are equal.

The left bus runs vertically between the upper and lower branch corners. A filled junction dot midway joins an outward left lead. The upper and lower left branch wires meet the respective positive plates. All are one conductor.
groups.nativeAssertionRule: Every wire and every split plate stroke has its own connects assertion naming shared endpoint IDs.

groups.description: The right bus runs vertically between upper and lower branch corners. A filled junction dot midway joins an outward right lead. The upper and lower right branch wires meet the respective negative plates. This conductor is separate from the left bus.
groups.nativeAssertionRule: Every wire and every split plate stroke has its own connects assertion naming shared endpoint IDs.

figures.absence: No battery, switch, current arrows, ground symbol, resistor, dielectric insert, units, numerical values, formula, caption or ellipsis is printed inside the PNG.
figures.modernRegularization: Square clean corners, aligned plate centers, uniform strokes and mobile-readable labels. Internal coordinates are uncalibrated layout, not given distances. Unicode subscripts preserve the mathematical labels; no added node names or circuit formulas.

figures.description: A single horizontal chain with exactly two capacitor pairs, not three capacitors despite the three U labels.

groups.description: The first pair has two separated vertical thick plates: positive on the left, negative on the right. +|q| is above/left, -|q| above/right and C_1 is below the pair. Neither q has a subscript.
The second pair is to the right, also left positive and right negative; it has +|q| and -|q| above and C_2 below. Both groups remain distinct.

A horizontal left lead ends at the first positive plate, with U_1 below it. A horizontal right lead leaves the second negative plate, with U_3 below it. No open circles or filled node dots are drawn at their outer ends.
groups.nativeAssertionRule: Each wire has a connects assertion.

groups.description: A single straight horizontal wire directly connects the first negative plate to the second positive plate. U_2 is printed below this middle wire. It has no branch, ground, battery or extra terminal. The connected negative and positive plates belong to the same isolated intermediate conductor group, not two separately grounded nodes.
groups.nativeAssertionRule: The wire has a connects assertion from cap1-negative-contact to cap2-positive-contact.
groups.interpretationFromFrozenProse: Equal magnitudes in the depicted charge labels are conditional on this intermediate conductor group initially having zero net charge and not leaking externally. Do not claim every arbitrary series circuit has equal voltage division.

figures.absence: No q subscripts, third capacitor, junction dots, external intermediate branch, voltage-equality mark, current arrow, ground, battery, equation, dimensions or caption is printed.
figures.modernRegularization: One clean horizontal chain with evenly drawn plate glyphs and labels enlarged to at least 16 px at all supplied actual media widths. Equal glyph size is schematic and does not claim equal capacitance or equal voltage. No new neutral-node label or charge-conservation equation is added.
